senses.gloss: c. (= בֵּי אִסְתַּרְקָא, Ithpe. noun of סרק) receptacle of hackled or hatcheled wool, whence mattress, cushion.
units: B. Kam. 117ᵃ חד ב׳ Ms. R. (ed. חדא fem.).—Pl. בִּיסְתַּרְקֵי, בִּסְ׳.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 34:6">Targ. Y. Deut. XXXIV, 6</cite> <he>בב׳ מילת</he> (not <he>כב׳</he>) with fine woolen mattresses.—B. Kam. l. c.
<cite ref="Taanit 21b:16">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מאיך להו ב׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="M01339"><he>מך</he></cite>) laid down before them mattresses (to sleep on).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 58a">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> (= <he>חביתא דאודדא</he> in an enigma).
